description: Sprint-2-carry novelty_ratio=0 ZeroDivisionError guard at lib/menu.py:112 ('novelty_ratio > 0' added to the conditional) has NO dedicated unit test. test_dispatch_integration_step6.py seeds novelty_quota_ratio=0.0 but only as scaffolding to keep the integration test deterministic — it does not assert the no-crash contract on lib.menu.pick_next with an empty/non-empty history under novelty_ratio=0. A regression that removes the '> 0' check would slip past the entire suite as long as history stays empty (because int(1.0/0.0) is never reached when history is []). The manifest extra-constraint #4 specifically demanded this test coverage exist; it does not.
